results.name: Bodyweight Windmill Cut
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend at the waist, rotating your torso to touch your right hand to your left foot 3-4 times in a pulsing motion, while keeping your left arm extended upward.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, touching your left hand to your right foot.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your movements are slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees to reduce strain on your lower back and hamstrings.
results.description: Bodyweight Windmill Cut is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Bouncing Circle Draw
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, legs slightly bent, and your hands lightly bent in front of your hips.
Slowly straighten your legs while simultaneously drawing circles with your hands, moving them outward and upward.
Encircle your hands inward, bringing them close together and downward as you bend your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your shoulders relaxed to avoid tension and enhance fluidity in your movements.
Focus on maintaining a consistent rhythm with both the leg movements and the circular hand motions.
results.description: Bouncing Circle Draw is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Biceps.

results.name: Bouncing Inner Thigh Tap
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended by your sides at shoulder level.
Rotate your torso to touch the inside of your right thigh with your left hand, slightly bending your knees as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, rotating your torso to touch the inside of your left thigh with your right hand, slightly bending your knees.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Keep your gaze forward to help maintain balance and proper alignment.
Engage your core muscles to support the rotational movement and protect your lower back.
Perform the exercise at a controlled pace to ensure proper form and muscle engagement.
results.description: Bouncing Inner Thigh Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Calves.

results.name: Box Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles or upright posts with your arms extended.
Lean forward at about 45 degrees with your body in a straight line.
Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep pushing for the set distance or time.
tips: Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Short steps keep the sled moving smoothly.
results.description: Box Sled Push is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Hamstrings, Shoulders.

results.name: Boxing Jab
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your feet shoulder-width apart, left foot forward, and hands up in a guard position near your chin.
Extend your left arm forward in a quick, snapping motion to throw a jab.
Quickly retract your left arm back to the guard position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your non-punching hand up to protect your face and maintain a balanced stance.
Engage your core to generate power and maintain stability.
Rotate your hips and shoulders slightly to add power to the jab.
results.description: Boxing Jab is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back.

Quickly retract your left arm back to the guard position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your non-punching hand up to protect your face and maintain a balanced stance.
Engage your core to generate power and maintain stability.
Focus on rotating your hips and shoulders to add power to the hook.
results.description: Boxing Left Hook is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back.
